screens.screen: home (main food view: popular slider + recommended list + bottom nav)

notes: Repo used: ardev-dev/mawsil (the Flutter app, GetX). ardev-dev/food-delivery-mawsil is its Django/DRF backend only (no Flutter code). UI is English/LTR, no custom font in pubspec, so the platform font is used. Colours from lib/src/utilities/app_colors.dart. Products come from a dead Heroku API, so names/prices are sample data and the product photos are drawn as neutral plate illustrations on the code's own placeholder colours (orange / #9294cc); the unused stock photo assets/image/food.jpg was not used. Doubts: (1) the home header in code shows the literal placeholders "contry" / "city"; drawn as a sample location (Saudi Arabia / Riyadh). (2) Hard-coded labels are kept exactly as in code, including their typos: "Indroduce", "With chinese charactristics", "Spicy", "4.5 1287 comments", "Normal / 1.7km / 32". (3) Bottom-nav badges 0-3 are what the code renders (badgeCount = tab index); badge size/position of the custom_navigation_bar package is approximated. The 4th tab is an empty "page 4" placeholder in code and is not drawn.
